name: Input Ingestion Subsystem
description: Accepts ICD CSV and Markdown narrative files from manual operators and parses them into canonical system graph structures

name: Threat Analysis Pipeline
description: Multi-stage LLM-driven pipeline that enriches canonical graph with trust boundaries and STRIDE scores then generates threats

name: LLM Provider Interface
description: Abstraction layer for vendor-agnostic LLM access (Grok XAI local XAI fixture modes)

name: Output Packaging Subsystem
description: Transforms threat analysis results into exportable STIX bundles diagrams and human-readable reports

name: Human-In-The-Loop Control System
description: HITL validation gates approval checkpoints and analyst review capabilities for threat model edits

name: State and Audit Subsystem
description: Maintains immutable run history canonical graph versioning and analyst edit provenance

name: Streamlit User Interface
description: Web-based dashboard for run management diagnostics heartbeat monitoring and interactive analysis

name: CSV/Markdown Parser
description: Parses uploaded ICD CSV and narrative Markdown files into intermediate JSON structures

name: Graph Canonicalizer
description: Transforms intermediate JSON into canonical system graph with subsystems components data flows and trust boundaries

name: Agent Orchestrator
description: Coordinates execution of all nine agents via LangGraph state machine including stage sequencing and validation gates

name: Input Normalizer Agent
description: Agent 01 - converts free-text and tabular inputs into canonical graph JSON

name: Context Builder Agent
description: Agent 02 - merges new submissions with existing canonical graphs non-destructively

name: Trust Boundary Validator Agent
description: Agent 03 - evaluates each data flow for trust boundary crossing and enriches boundary metadata

name: STRIDE Scorer Agent
description: Agent 04 - assigns STRIDE severity scores and justification for each data flow

name: Threat Generator Agent
description: Agent 05 - generates concrete threats for high-risk flows using STRIDE context

name: STIX Packager Agent
description: Agent 06 - transforms threat data into valid STIX 2.1 bundle objects

name: LLM Adapter
description: Provider-agnostic abstraction for LLM API calls with fallback fixture mode support

name: Model Configuration Manager
description: Selects and configures LLM provider model and endpoints without source code changes

name: STIX Exporter
description: Packages threat artifacts into valid STIX 2.1 JSON bundles with identity attack-pattern and relationship objects

name: Diagram Generator
description: Creates Mermaid flowchart diagrams showing system architecture trust boundaries and threat relationships

name: Report Generator
description: Produces comprehensive markdown threat model reports with executive summary findings and mitigation tables

name: HITL Gate Manager
description: Enforces analyst approval checkpoints at configurable pipeline stages with override capabilities

name: Audit Logger
description: Records all analyst edits threats approvals and run state changes with timestamp and provenance metadata

name: State Manager
description: Maintains canonical graph state and intermediate stage states with immutable versioning

name: Run Dashboard
description: Primary UI for run execution monitoring displaying stage progress run results and artifact downloads

name: Diagnostics Panel
description: Secondary UI showing real-time pipeline stage details LLM adapter logs and system health metrics

name: Heartbeat Monitor
description: Detects pipeline hangs and timeouts via periodic health check signals with visual age indicator
